text:
maya: Heads up — pre-merge SAST hit on PR #4321, rule SAST-RULE-1029 (possible SQL concat). Looks like a false positive from our query builder. PR: https://redwood.internal/pr/4321
aj: @maya can you paste the exact snippet the scanner flagged? If it's an FP we can request a policy exception and suppress.
maya: flagged snippet (scanner saw literal concat): ```js
const q = `SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ${userId}`
// actual call goes through queryBuilder which parameterizes
db.query(queryBuilder.build(q))
```
The scanner matched the template string but we use queryBuilder to escape params.
security-bot: Scanner report attached: SAST-RULE-1029 found in repo-api at commit 9f3a2. See /scans/9f3a2.
sam: If this is FP we need owner signoff + evidence (unit test or smoke) and confirmation no secrets/KMS decrypts are exposed. Also check RBAC scope for anyone who can push this.
maya: Not touching keystore or KMS. No decrypt calls in this PR. I can add a minimal repro unit test showing parameters are bound. I also see DAST flagged /admin/login in a separate run — unrelated but noted.
elena: Oncall here — if this blocks release we can fast-track. Suggested steps: 1) confirm FP with minimal repro test, 2) add suppression with justification and link to evidence, 3) security approves and we run post-merge DAST smoke. :lock:
aj: Proposed suppression justification (draft): "False positive — dynamic query builder parameterizes inputs; verified with unit test and CI logs. No KMS decrypts or secret literals in PR." Put that in the suppression request.
sam: Who owns scanner exemptions for repo-api? @aj? I'll take primary reviewer but need the full repro + CI link. Also want a short audit check: confirm there were no KMS decrypt audit events around the PR's CI window.
maya: Creating ticket and attaching test + CI traces. CI job: https://ci.redwood/internal/4321/jobs/12 . No KMS activity found via quick grep on audit logs. I redacted identifiers and uploaded logs.
ci-bot: SEC-2026 created from PR comment by maya — https://redwood.internal/security/SEC-2026 ; status: open; assignee: sam.
sam: I'll review SEC-2026 now. Quick question — even if there are no KMS decrypts, please include a note about RBAC: who can merge this PR and whether they have elevated rights. We require that for exceptions touching scan rules that could mask secret exposure.
maya: Merge team is small: core-api-eng (alice, bob, maya). No elevated deploy-only bots. I added squad list to the ticket.
sam: OK provisional approve pending post-merge DAST smoke and confirmation of audit logs. I'll add my review on the ticket and mark as P2.
elena: Assigned to sam for signoff. I'll queue a DAST smoke run for after merge and verify audit trails. :thumbsup:
aj: Thanks — once sam approves we can land. Please add a short note in the release changelog mentioning the suppression and link to SEC-2026 so we have traceability.
maya: Done — release note line and ticket linked. Will merge once sam flips to approved. Thanks everyone.
